messages.content: React 18 + Vite PWA (vite-plugin-pwa / workbox), runs offline on cheap low-end Android phones. I need a minimal APP-WIDE sound effect layer for UI interactions: about 5 short sounds (add item, remove item, confirm, error, open panel). Constraints: must not delay the interaction, must work fully offline, must be silenced by an existing performance Lite Mode boolean, total asset budget under 100KB, must not break service-worker precaching. Answer: 1) HTMLAudioElement vs Web Audio API vs a single audio sprite: which and why for exactly this case, considering playback latency on weak Android. 2) The mobile autoplay-unlock problem and the minimal correct fix. 3) Handling rapid repeated triggers (15 taps in 10 seconds) without the sound cutting itself off or stacking badly. 4) File format and encoding settings for smallest size at acceptable quality for short UI blips. 5) Exactly what to add to vite-plugin-pwa workbox globPatterns so audio precaches. 6) The smallest sane React hook API. Include a minimal code sketch. Terse, no preamble.
